_comment: rq2-oracle-buffer: switching-oracle headroom with finite machine buffers (FJSSPConfig.inputBufferCapacity / outputBufferCapacity, 0 = unbounded). Every regime: randomized generator, random warm-up, 5400 s agent window, layout D, 7 AGVs unless overridden; the jobs are identical across regimes (scenarios/buffers.py only sets the two keys). Input buffer = jobs queued at or routed to a machine (a full machine is not a routing candidate). Output buffer = finished jobs waiting for pickup (full -> the machine holds its next finished job and cannot start another op). Reference: on the randomized family at 7 AGVs about 17% of deliveries already arrive at a machine with 3+ jobs waiting (AGVF_check machine_handoffs.csv, belt capacity 3).

buf-inf.what: unbounded buffers on the new build (reference; must match rq2-oracle-screen base-w on non-FIFO pairs)

in3-out1-agv5.what: input 3, output 1, 5 AGVs (slower pickups make output blocking bite)
